🧬 Plus Two Zoology Christmas Exam 2026 – Sex Determination | Most Important Question Discussion | Principles of Inheritance and Variation | Kerala Class 12 Biology

Attention Kerala Plus Two Zoology students! Are you preparing for the upcoming Plus Two Christmas Exam 2026? Don't miss this important question discussion on Sex Determination, a fundamental topic from the chapter Principles of Inheritance and Variation! 💯

In this RK Nex Plus Two session, we explain the different mechanisms of Sex Determination, including the XX–XY system, XX–XO system, ZZ–ZW system, and haplodiploid sex determination.

Learn how sex chromosomes influence sex determination in different organisms, understand the differences between male and female heterogamety, and revise important NCERT-based Genetics concepts through simple explanations and examination-oriented questions.

This session is designed to help Kerala Plus Two students strengthen their conceptual understanding, remember important examples, and prepare confidently for the Christmas Examination 2026.

📌 In This Video:

✅ Plus Two Zoology Christmas Exam 2026
✅ Sex Determination – Most Important Question
✅ Principles of Inheritance and Variation
✅ Introduction to Sex Determination
✅ Chromosomal Basis of Sex Determination
✅ Sex Chromosomes and Autosomes
✅ XX–XY Type of Sex Determination
✅ Sex Determination in Human Beings
✅ Male Heterogamety and Female Homogamety
✅ XX–XO Type of Sex Determination
✅ Sex Determination in Grasshoppers
✅ ZZ–ZW Type of Sex Determination
✅ Sex Determination in Birds
✅ Female Heterogamety
✅ Haplodiploid Sex Determination
✅ Sex Determination in Honeybees
✅ Role of Fertilisation in Honeybee Sex Determination
✅ Differences Between Sex Determination Mechanisms
✅ Important NCERT-Based Zoology Questions
✅ Christmas Exam Genetics Quick Revision

🎯 Why Watch This Video?

Sex Determination is an important concept in Genetics that explains how the sex of an organism is established through different biological mechanisms.

In human beings, females typically possess XX chromosomes, while males typically possess XY chromosomes. The sperm contributes either an X or a Y chromosome, which usually determines the chromosomal sex of the offspring.

Different organisms exhibit different mechanisms of sex determination:
- XX–XY System: Found in humans and many other mammals.
- XX–XO System: Found in certain insects, including grasshoppers.
- ZZ–ZW System: Found in birds, where females are heterogametic.
- Haplodiploid System: Found in honeybees, where males generally develop from unfertilised eggs and females from fertilised eggs.
Understanding these mechanisms, chromosome combinations, and important examples helps students answer comparison-based, diagram-based, and application-level questions from the chapter Principles of Inheritance and Variation.

This session focuses on examination-oriented concepts and easy learning techniques to help students remember important Genetics facts.

Whether you're preparing for the Plus Two Christmas Exam 2026, Second Terminal Examination, or Plus Two Public Exam 2027, this video can help strengthen your Zoology preparation.
